title: T01 retest - The padlock is not the safety sign
source_words: tests/inputs/T01_tech_short.md (phrase-start times given in the brief)

beats.label: the site itself is the scam
most phishing sites have the padlock
check the address, not the lock
lock and all - loop to the opening lock

shots.subject: padlock icon of the FAKE bar (owner hidden)

subject_motion.what: padlock fades in 0->100% opacity, power2.out
padlock glow 0->40% and back, sine.inOut (on 'in your browser?')

shots.notes: URL text kept at 18 px screen blur (simulated focus hide). Same frame as the S11 end frame (loop).

shots.subject: padlock vs the word SAFE

subject_motion.what: padlock 240 px at screen (540,960); '≠' draws in at (540,1150) on 'NOT'
'SAFE SITE' types in at (540,1260)

shots.transition_out: graphic match cut on 'It' 5.2: padlock keeps screen position and size

shots.subject: padlock on the line between YOU and the SITE

camera.reason: show where the padlock really sits: on the connection, not on the site

subject_motion.what: line draws phone (540,1230) -> site (540,590) through the padlock
line turns steel blue #5B7FA6, sealed-tube stroke; label 'ENCRYPTED' at (680,910)

shots.subject: middle node and its scrambled readout

subject_motion.what: readout panel under the grey middle node fills with scrambled glyphs 'k#9Q x7&p ...'

shots.transition_out: hard cut on 'But' 11.8 (back to the S03 end frame)

shots.subject: the site at the end of the safe line

camera.reason: look hard at the destination: the threat is at the end of the line, not in the line

subject_motion.what: password dots travel up the blue line into the site, untouched
on 'scam': a red hook #E5484D lifts the dots; site outline turns red; vignette 25%
3x4 cards (260x180) pop in, stagger 0.1 s from the centre card (the S05 site)
on 'have the padlock too': the same white padlock appears on all 12 cards at once
dispenser at (540,700) issues certificate tokens; one lands at (540,860)
label '$0 · automatic' at (540,1180)

shots.angle: over the right shoulder, 20 deg down onto the phone
shots.subject: thumb on the address bar (AI video)

subject_motion.what: thumb rises to the top bar (generated)
comp: yellow #FFD23F underline draws under the (still blurred) address
comp: padlock dims 100->40% on 'not the lock'

camera.reason: travel from the lock to the name the viewer has not seen yet: the lesson as a camera move

focus.reason: the address was soft since S01; it becomes sharp on 'Real bank' - the first time the viewer can read it

subject_motion.what: yellow underline under 'northbank.com'; tag 'REAL' above the bar

shots.subject: FAKE address bar, the wrong letter

subject_motion.what: fake bar 'northbamk.com' fully visible; tag 'FAKE' in red
red circle draws around the 'm' in 'bamk'

shots.subject: both bars, two identical padlocks; ends on the fake padlock

camera.reason: land exactly on the S01 frame so the loop shows that the opening padlock belonged to the fake site

focus.to: fake-bar padlock (URL blurs back to 18 px)
focus.reason: return to the opening trap: lock sharp, address soft - the exact frame the viewer started on

subject_motion.what: both padlocks pulse once together (scale 1.0->1.15->1.0)

music_hints.hint: quiet pulse bed; nothing melodic under speech
drop-out or stop on 'NOT' - the first turn
single accent on 'Fake' / the red circle at 26.5
